day4_night_start.name: Me
day4_night_start.text: *I'm back home. Lying in bed, today's memories replay like a film.*

day4_night_yuna_sneak.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_sneak.text: *10 PM. A message came from Yuna. 'School back gate. Come now.'*

day4_night_yuna_sneak_2.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_sneak_2.text: *My heart is pounding. The 'truth' Yuna mentioned... am I finally going to find out?*

day4_night_yuna_arrive.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_arrive.text: "...You came. I thought you'd be late."

day4_night_yuna_arrive_2.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_arrive_2.text: *The school back gate. Yuna stood under a streetlight. Her expression looked more resolute than usual.*

day4_night_yuna_wall.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_wall.text: "...Before we go inside, there's something you need to see first. Come this way."

day4_night_yuna_wall_2.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_wall_2.text: *Yuna led me to the back of the school building. A dark corner with no streetlights. When her flashlight lit up the old concrete exterior wall— I saw the crack.*

day4_night_yuna_wall_3.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_wall_3.text: *'Crack' was too mild a word for it. Running vertically along one side of the exterior wall, a fissure as wide as a forearm stretched from top to bottom. Chunks of concrete had already fallen away in several places.*

day4_night_yuna_wall_4.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_wall_4.text: "This... how long has it been like this?"

day4_night_yuna_wall_5.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_wall_5.text: "At least three years. But the school kept delaying repairs. They've blocked students from coming over here."

day4_night_yuna_wall_6.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_wall_6.text: "This building had problems from the moment it was built. It wasn't constructed according to the design. Rebar spacing, concrete mix ratio... all of it was below standard."

day4_night_yuna_enter_honest.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_enter_honest.text: "...I like that you're honest. It's okay—I'm right here beside you."

day4_night_yuna_wall_8.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_wall_8.text: "The contractor was 'Hanjin Construction.' A company whose CEO is the brother-in-law of the foundation's chairman. Do you know where 700 million of the 1.5 billion won in construction costs went?"

day4_night_yuna_wall_10.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_wall_10.text: "Into the foundation's accounts. They siphoned off the construction funds and did shoddy work. This crack is the proof. The entire school building is actually dangerous."

day4_night_yuna_wall_11.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_wall_11.text: *I looked at the crack again. It wasn't just ordinary aging. This was the trace left behind by someone's greed. The fact that hundreds of students were inside this building every day suddenly felt terrifying.*

day4_night_yuna_wall_choice.name: Me
choices: "...The school knew about this and hid it? That's unforgivable."
"...Should we really be getting involved in this?"

day4_night_yuna_wall_anger.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_wall_anger.text: "...That's how I felt at first too. But anger alone isn't enough. That's why I needed evidence. It's downstairs. Follow me."

day4_night_yuna_wall_fear.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_wall_fear.text: "...Being scared is natural. I felt the same way for a whole year. But now you know. Can you pretend you don't?"

day4_night_yuna_wall_end.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_wall_end.text: *Yuna's words struck deep. I couldn't pretend not to know. I'd already seen this crack with my own eyes.*

day4_night_yuna_arrive_3.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_arrive_3.text: "...I have something to show you today. Are you prepared?"

day4_night_yuna_choice.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_choice.text: *The look in Yuna's eyes is serious.*
choices: "Of course. That's why I came."
"...Honestly, I'm a little scared."

day4_night_yuna_corridor.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_corridor.text: *Yuna opened the back gate lock with practiced ease. As if she'd done this many times before.*

day4_night_yuna_corridor_2.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_corridor_2.text: *The empty school hallway. Only the dim emergency lights were on. The place that was so noisy during the day now felt like even a breath would echo.*

day4_night_yuna_corridor_3.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_corridor_3.text: "...The underground archives. A section the school sealed off. Everything's in here."

day4_night_yuna_basement.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_basement.text: *As we descended underground, the air turned cold. The smell of dust and old documents stung my nose.*

day4_night_yuna_basement_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_basement_2.text: "This school's foundation... 'Sungjin Academy.' They claim to be an elite educational institution, but they've been operating a slush fund systematically for the past ten years."

day4_night_yuna_basement_4.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_basement_4.text: "Embezzling student welfare funds, false claims for facility repair costs, misappropriation of donations... It's all here."

day4_night_yuna_documents.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_documents.text: *Yuna pulled out a worn file from the shelf. Dense numbers and stamps filled the pages. This is... a real ledger.*

day4_night_yuna_documents_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_documents_2.text: "Especially this building... the east staircase of the main hall. Records say it was renovated three years ago, but in reality, not a single penny was spent."

day4_night_yuna_documents_3.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_documents_3.text: "...And on those stairs, an accident happened one year ago."

day4_night_yuna_truth_choice.name: Me
choices: "...Who got hurt?"
"Yuna... are you okay?"

day4_night_yuna_senpai_concern.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_senpai_concern.text: "...You're the first person to ask me that."

day4_night_yuna_senpai_reveal.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_senpai_reveal.text: "...Lee Junho, a senior. He was the student council president at the time. He found out about the foundation's corruption and was gathering evidence."

day4_night_yuna_senpai_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_senpai_2.text: "He was... a person with a strong sense of justice. Almost foolishly so. He could never look away when someone was being wronged."

day4_night_yuna_senpai_3.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_senpai_3.text: "Then one day... he fell from that east staircase. The school ruled it an 'accidental fall.'"

day4_night_yuna_senpai_4.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_senpai_4.text: "...An accidental fall? The person who was investigating the corruption?"

day4_night_yuna_senpai_5.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_senpai_5.text: "...The old staircase railing that was never repaired broke. If the foundation hadn't embezzled the repair funds, that accident would never have happened."

day4_night_yuna_senpai_6.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_senpai_6.text: "It was the day before he planned to take the evidence to the Board of Education. Whether it was coincidence or not... I still don't know."

day4_night_yuna_senpai_death.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_senpai_death.text: "He... passed away in the hospital a few days later. He never woke up."

day4_night_yuna_silence.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_silence.text: *Yuna's hands were shaking. Her fingertips, gripping the documents, had turned white.*

day4_night_yuna_silence_choice.name: Me
choices: Take Yuna's hand
"...Keep talking. I'm listening."

day4_night_yuna_hand_2.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_hand_2.text: *Yuna's hand was cold. But she didn't pull away.*

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_intro.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_intro.text: "...And one more thing. This is the most important part."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_intro_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_intro_2.text: "The foundation's corruption started with the chairman ten years ago. But now... what's happened in the last two years is different. More calculated, more organized."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_3.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_3.text: "...Seoyeon? Seoyeon from our class? What are you—"

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_4.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_4.text: "Seoyeon is the chairman's granddaughter. The chairman of this school's foundation, 'Sungjin Academy'... the granddaughter of the Sungjin Group chairman."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_5.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_5.text: *My mind went blank. Seoyeon... that girl who always smiled so brightly. Those curious eyes. The chairman's granddaughter?*

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_6.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_6.text: "Misuse of student council funds, fraudulent scholarship applications, manipulation of school disciplinary records... everything that happened in the last two years, Seoyeon designed it herself, with the foundation backing her."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_7.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_7.text: "...I can't believe it. Seoyeon isn't that kind of person."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_8.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_8.text: "...I thought the same thing. At first. But look at these documents."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_9.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_9.text: *Yuna handed me a stack of documents. Student council financial reports, scholarship selection lists, school disciplinary committee meeting minutes... Every document had the Seoyeon's same signature.*

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_10.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_10.text: "Seoyeon used her position as student council president to control the flow of money. On the surface, a perfect student — behind the scenes, doing exactly what the foundation told her to."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_11.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_11.text: *The documents in my hands trembled. Seoyeon's smiling face flashed through my mind. That natural smile, those bright eyes... was all of it an act?*

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_12.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_12.text: "...Whether Seoyeon is a bad person or not, I don't know. She's been inside that system since birth. But that doesn't excuse it. Because there are real people who were hurt."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_choice.name: Me
choices: "...I want to ask Seoyeon directly."
"...Okay. There's evidence. Let's move forward."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_doubt.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_doubt.text: "...That's not possible. It's still too dangerous. The moment Seoyeon realizes, the evidence could disappear."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_doubt_2.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_doubt_2.text: *I knew she was right... but I couldn't easily accept it. Seoyeon's face kept floating before my eyes.*

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_bridge.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_bridge.text: *The cold of the basement seeped into my bones. Seoyeon. The foundation. The senior's death. The crack in the wall. Everything was connecting into one. And Yuna had been carrying all of this alone.*

day4_night_yuna_resemblance.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resemblance.text: "...Actually, there's one more thing I need to tell you."

day4_night_yuna_resemblance_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resemblance_2.text: "When you first transferred here... I almost stopped breathing."

day4_night_yuna_resemblance_4.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resemblance_4.text: "You... look like Junho. Your eyes, your aura. Even that feeling of never being able to stand by when something's wrong."

day4_night_yuna_resemblance_5.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resemblance_5.text: "...So at first, I was scared. Afraid the same thing would happen again. Afraid you'd be in danger too."

day4_night_yuna_resemblance_6.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resemblance_6.text: "But at the same time... with you by my side, I felt like I could finish what he couldn't."

day4_night_yuna_resemblance_7.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_resemblance_7.text: *So that's why. The reason Yuna showed interest in me from the start. When she called me a 'special light'... was I just the senior's shadow?*

day4_night_yuna_critical_choice.name: Me
choices: "I'm not him. I'm me. But still... I'll fight alongside you."
"Even if I'm his stand-in, that's fine. I want to be the person you need."
"...So you approached me because of him? As a replacement?"

day4_night_yuna_moved.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_moved.text: "...I know. You are you. Maybe at first I was chasing the senior's shadow. But now..."

day4_night_yuna_touched.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_touched.text: "Idiot... you can't just say things like that."

day4_night_yuna_touched_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_touched_2.text: "You're not a stand-in. You... are already more than enough, just as yourself."

day4_night_yuna_confronted_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_confronted_2.text: "...I won't deny it. At first, that's how it was. But... as we spent time together, that changed. This is real."

day4_night_yuna_confronted_3.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_confronted_3.text: "...Even if you don't believe me, I'll prove it."

day4_night_yuna_resolve.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resolve.text: "...I made copies of these documents. The originals stay here."

day4_night_yuna_resolve_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resolve_2.text: "What the senior couldn't finish... I want to see it through this time. I'm reporting it to the Press and Board of Education."

day4_night_yuna_resolve_3.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_resolve_3.text: *Determination filled Yuna's eyes. This wasn't mere curiosity. She'd been uncovering the truth alone for an entire year.*

day4_night_yuna_resolve_4.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resolve_4.text: "...But it could be dangerous. The foundation won't sit still."

day4_night_yuna_resolve_5.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_resolve_5.text: "...Let's do this together. Don't carry it all alone."

day4_night_yuna_resolve_end.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resolve_end.text: Yuna gently takes your hand, her touch no longer cold, but warm and seeking comfort.

day4_night_yuna_exit.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_exit.text: *We slipped out of the school. The cold night breeze blew, but it felt less cold with Yuna beside me.*

day4_night_yuna_exit_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_exit_2.text: "...Thank you for today. It's the first time I've told anyone what I've been carrying alone."

day4_night_yuna_exit_3.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_exit_3.text: "...It was a heavy day, wasn't it?"

day4_night_yuna_exit_choice.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_exit_choice.text: *Under the night sky, Yuna smiles awkwardly.*
choices: "No. Because I got to know you better."
"Next time, let's go on a real date. Somewhere like a café."

day4_night_yuna_exit_warm.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_exit_warm.text: "...That's not fair, saying something like that."

day4_night_yuna_exit_promise.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_exit_promise.text: "...A café. I'd like that. Can I pick the place this time?"

day4_night_yuna_farewell.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_farewell.text: *Yuna stopped as she was about to turn around. And she gripped my collar tightly.*

day4_night_yuna_farewell_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_farewell_2.text: I won't let you die like he did. To protect you... I'd rather break you and tie you to my side.

day4_night_yuna_farewell_3.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_farewell_3.text: You're mine. You can't go anywhere.

day4_night_yuna_home.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_home.text: *I returned home. Yuna's chilling gaze and tight grip won't leave my mind.*

day4_night_yuna_home_2.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_home_2.text: *I had a feeling that what she meant by 'protecting' might be different from what I thought.*

day4_night_seoyeon_call_2_normal.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_call_2_normal.text: "...Hey, it's me. If you're not busy... could you come out for a bit?"

day4_night_seoyeon_angry_call.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_angry_call.text: "...Why did you lie to me yesterday? I want to talk in person. If you're not busy... could you come out for a bit?"

day4_night_seoyeon_call_3.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_call_3.text: *Seoyeon's voice sounds different from usual. No warmth, and it seems like she's trembling.*

day4_night_seoyeon_call_4.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_call_4.text: "...You know the park near my house, right? I'll wait there."

day4_night_seoyeon_park.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_park.text: *I arrived at the park. Seoyeon was sitting alone on a bench. Instead of her usual neat uniform, she wore casual clothes.*

day4_night_seoyeon_park_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_park_2.text: "...You came. Sorry for calling you out so suddenly."

day4_night_seoyeon_park_3.name: Me
choices: "What happened? Are you okay?"
Sit next to her without saying anything

day4_night_seoyeon_concern.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_concern.text: "...If I said I was fine, that would be a lie."

day4_night_seoyeon_silent_sit.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_silent_sit.text: "...Thank you. Just sitting next to me... that's the best thing."

day4_night_seoyeon_open.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_open.text: "...Mom called today. She and Dad had another fight."

day4_night_seoyeon_open_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_open_2.text: "Our house... looks perfect from the outside, right? Big house, nice car, student council president daughter."

day4_night_seoyeon_open_3.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_open_3.text: "But actually... Mom and Dad haven't lived under the same roof for a year now. They just haven't filed for divorce yet."

day4_night_seoyeon_open_5.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_open_5.text: "Mom said, 'At least you need to be perfect for this family to hold together.' So... student council, grades, I couldn't let go of any of it."

day4_night_seoyeon_open_6.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_open_6.text: "I had to smile for everyone. 'Seoyeon is always so bright,' 'Seoyeon is good at everything.' Those words... started to feel like a prison."

day4_night_seoyeon_open_7.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_open_7.text: "I wasn't smiling—I was 'performing' a smile. Every single day."

day4_night_seoyeon_tear.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_tear.text: *Tears spilled from Seoyeon's eyes. Glistening under the streetlight. It was the first time I'd ever seen her cry.*

day4_night_seoyeon_tear_choice.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_tear_choice.text: *Seoyeon is crying. I've never seen this side of her.*
choices: Hug Seoyeon
Offer a pinky promise

day4_night_seoyeon_hug_2.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_hug_2.text: *Seoyeon buried her face in my chest. Her small shoulders were trembling.*

day4_night_seoyeon_hug_3.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_hug_3.text: "...It's been so long since I cried like this. Crying in front of someone... this is the first time."

day4_night_seoyeon_pinky.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_pinky.text: "I promise. Whenever you want to cry, you can cry with me."

day4_night_seoyeon_pinky_3.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_pinky_3.text: *Seoyeon locked her trembling pinky with mine. And then the tears she'd been holding back poured out.*

day4_night_seoyeon_pinky_4.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_pinky_4.text: "...You fool, why are you... so kind to me..."

day4_night_seoyeon_real.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_real.text: "...Even during our date today, I was scared. Am I allowed to be this happy? Will this happiness crumble too?"

day4_night_seoyeon_real_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_real_2.text: "Are you... okay with a me that's not perfect?"

day4_night_seoyeon_real_choice.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_real_choice.text: *Seoyeon is looking up at me with trembling eyes.*
choices: "I like the Seoyeon right now more than the perfect one."
"Not the class president Seoyeon—just Seoyeon is my girlfriend."
"Honestly, I always thought you were perfect. But... thank you for showing me this side too."

day4_night_seoyeon_accept_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_accept_2.text: "...I'll never forget those words. If I do... we made a pinky promise, after all."

day4_night_seoyeon_gf_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_gf_2.text: "...Ah, my heart is pounding so hard I might die. You can't just say things like that..."

day4_night_seoyeon_honest_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_honest_2.text: "From now on... I won't act in front of you. I promise."

day4_night_seoyeon_resolve.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_resolve.text: "...You know what? I've made up my mind."

day4_night_seoyeon_resolve_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_resolve_2.text: "I'm going to tell Mom. That I want to be myself before being 'the perfect daughter.'"

day4_night_seoyeon_resolve_3.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_resolve_3.text: Since you've seen me at my lowest like this... you can never leave me now.

day4_night_seoyeon_resolve_end.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_resolve_end.text: If you smile at another girl... I don't know what I'll do then. Got it?

day4_night_seoyeon_farewell.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_farewell.text: *We left the park and walked together to my house. Seoyeon hugged my arm tightly and wouldn't let go.*

day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_2.text: ...I showed you an ugly side of me today, but you didn't run away. I'm glad.

day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_3.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_3.text: "Run away? I actually like you more now."

day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_4.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_4.text: ......Never forget those words. You're mine now.

day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_5.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_5.text: *As Seoyeon turned to leave, she said in a small voice.*

day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_6.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_6.text: *As Seoyeon turned around, she gave a chilling but sweet smile.*

day4_night_seoyeon_home.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_home.text: *Back home. Seoyeon's tears keep coming back to me. The real face behind the perfect student council president... I want to share that heavy burden.*

day4_night_seoyeon_home_2.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_home_2.text: *Tomorrow... I want her smile to come from the heart, not from acting.*

day4_night_dain_gym.name: Me
day4_night_dain_gym.text: *9:30 PM. A message from Dain. 'Hey, you free rn?? lol Can you come to school??'*

day4_night_dain_gym_2.name: Me
day4_night_dain_gym_2.text: *Another message right away. 'Nvm just come lol! Gym back door is open!'*

day4_night_dain_gym_3.name: Me
day4_night_dain_gym_3.text: *Dain at the school gym at this hour? Something feels off... Let's go check.*

day4_night_dain_arrive.name: Me
day4_night_dain_arrive.text: *I entered the gym. In the darkness lit only by emergency lights, Dain was alone, bumping a volleyball.*

day4_night_dain_arrive_2.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_arrive_2.text: "Oh! You actually came?! Hehe, that's my boyfriend!"

day4_night_dain_arrive_3.name: Me
day4_night_dain_arrive_3.text: *But... something's off. Dain seems to be smiling harder than usual.*

day4_night_dain_spike.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_spike.text: "Toss for me! Just once! I'll show you my spike!!"

day4_night_dain_spike_2.name: Me
day4_night_dain_spike_2.text: *I tossed the ball to Dain. She jumped high and slammed the spike down.*

day4_night_dain_spike_3.name: Me
day4_night_dain_spike_3.text: *The moment she landed—Dain grabbed her right knee and crumpled to the floor.*

day4_night_dain_hurt_3.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_hurt_3.text: "Ow ow!! I'm fine!! Just tweaked it a little haha, no biggie..."

day4_night_dain_hurt_4.name: Me
day4_night_dain_hurt_4.text: *Dain is smiling, but her hand gripping her knee has gone white.*
choices: "Don't lie. Let me see."
"Dain. You're not okay."

day4_night_dain_check.name: Me
day4_night_dain_check.text: *When I tried to look at Dain's knee, she flinched and pulled away.*

day4_night_dain_secret.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_secret.text: "...Fine. I was trying to hide it."

day4_night_dain_secret_2.name: Me
day4_night_dain_secret_2.text: *Dain rolled up her knee brace. Her knee was badly swollen.*

day4_night_dain_secret_3.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_secret_3.text: "...Torn ACL. I injured it last year. Had surgery but... it never fully healed."

day4_night_dain_secret_5.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_secret_5.text: "The doctor said, 'Daily life is fine, but playing like before is too much.'"

day4_night_dain_secret_6.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_secret_6.text: "Athletic scholarship, going pro... All gone. Just like that."

day4_night_dain_dream.name: Me
day4_night_dain_dream.text: *...For Dain, who lived for volleyball, that must have been a death sentence.*

day4_night_dain_dream_2.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_dream_2.text: "...You know how I always smile? Nobody knows it's an act."

day4_night_dain_dream_3.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_dream_3.text: "'Dain is always so energetic!' Every time I hear that... I laugh for real. But inside, my knee burns every single day."

day4_night_dain_dream_4.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_dream_4.text: "Even on our date today, when we were running around... it actually hurt. But I didn't want to show it."

day4_night_dain_dream_5.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_dream_5.text: "I know I need to let go. But... I just wanted to jump one more time. On this court."

day4_night_dain_cry.name: Me
day4_night_dain_cry.text: *Dain hugged the volleyball tight and lowered her head. Her shoulders were shaking. The girl who was always bright and cheerful... was crying.*

day4_night_dain_cry_choice.name: Me
choices: "Your dream isn't just volleyball. Let's find a new dream together."
"You can cry. You don't have to pretend to be okay. Not with me."
"...Want me to toss one more? One last time."

day4_night_dain_future_2.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_future_2.text: "...I've thought about it. Coaching, training... I do love teaching people."

day4_night_dain_future_3.name: Me
day4_night_dain_future_3.text: "You'd be the most passionate coach in the world."

day4_night_dain_future_4.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_future_4.text: "...Dummy, if you say things like that I'll cry again..."

day4_night_dain_tears_ok_2.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_tears_ok_2.text: "...You dummy... if you say that... I'll actually cry...!!"

day4_night_dain_tears_ok_3.name: Me
day4_night_dain_tears_ok_3.text: *Dain buried her face in my chest and started sobbing. Her cries echoed through the empty gym.*

day4_night_dain_tears_ok_4.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_tears_ok_4.text: "...I couldn't tell anyone... every day, alone... I was so scared..."

day4_night_dain_last_spike_2.name: Me
day4_night_dain_last_spike_2.text: "Not 'last'—it's 'the last one before a new beginning.'"

day4_night_dain_last_spike_3.name: Me
day4_night_dain_last_spike_3.text: *I tossed the ball. Dain gritted her teeth and jumped, slamming down the best spike I'd ever seen. She grabbed her knee on landing... but she was smiling.*

day4_night_dain_last_spike_4.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_last_spike_4.text: "...Haha. It hurts. But... it felt amazing."

day4_night_dain_last_spike_5.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_last_spike_5.text: "...Thank you. I think I can really let go now."

day4_night_dain_resolve_2.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_resolve_2.text: "I've decided. I'm going to talk to my doctor properly and focus on rehabilitation."

day4_night_dain_resolve_3.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_resolve_3.text: If I can never play volleyball again... you have to take responsibility for my whole life. Got it?

day4_night_dain_resolve_end.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_resolve_end.text: I'm not joking. You're mine now, so don't even think about running away. Even if my legs break, I'll chase after you.

day4_night_dain_farewell.name: Me
day4_night_dain_farewell.text: *We left the gym. Dain linked her arm tightly with mine, putting strength into it as if she would never let go.*

day4_night_dain_farewell_2.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_farewell_2.text: ...Since you've seen all my weaknesses today, you can't escape from me now. Just set tosses by my side for the rest of your life.

day4_night_dain_farewell_3.name: Me
day4_night_dain_farewell_3.text: "I liked that side of you too."

day4_night_dain_farewell_4.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_farewell_4.text: "...Huh? Who says 'I liked it' about their crying girlfriend? Weirdo."

day4_night_dain_farewell_5.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_farewell_5.text: "...But thanks. Really. Without you, I would've kept carrying this alone forever."

day4_night_dain_farewell_6.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_farewell_6.text: "...Starting tomorrow, I'll smile for real. Not fake—for real."

day4_night_dain_home.name: Me
day4_night_dain_home.text: *Back home. Dain's tears from the gym keep flashing before my eyes. The pain she hid behind her constant brightness... it weighs heavy on my heart.*

day4_night_dain_home_2.name: Me
day4_night_dain_home_2.text: *Tomorrow... I want it to be a day where Dain can smile from the heart. I'll be right there beside her.*

day4_night_teacher_call.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_call.text: *9 PM. A call from the teacher.*

day4_night_teacher_call_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_call_2.text: "...Hello? It's me. Are you... free right now?"

day4_night_teacher_call_3.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_call_3.text: *Her voice sounds different from usual. Not the confident voice from the classroom... it sounds like she's about to break.*

day4_night_teacher_call_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_call_4.text: "...There's a café near the school. Can we meet there?"

day4_night_teacher_cafe.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_cafe.text: *I arrived at the café. She was sitting in a corner booth. Instead of her usual neat outfit, she was in casual clothes.*

day4_night_teacher_cafe_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_cafe_2.text: "...Thanks for coming. Sorry for calling you out so suddenly."

day4_night_teacher_cafe_3.name: Me
choices: "Did something happen?"
Offer her coffee and wait quietly

day4_night_teacher_concern.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_concern.text: "...It's not so much that something happened. I just... thought a lot today."

day4_night_teacher_wait.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_wait.text: "...Thank you. Just sitting next to me without saying anything... I really like that about you."

day4_night_teacher_open.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_open.text: "...At the faculty meeting yesterday, the vice principal said, 'Be careful about getting too personally close to students.'"

day4_night_teacher_open_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_open_2.text: "Maybe it wasn't about us directly. But... my heart nearly stopped."

day4_night_teacher_open_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_open_3.text: "I'm... a teacher. Your homeroom teacher. I know this isn't right."

day4_night_teacher_open_5.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_open_5.text: "But on the way home, I kept thinking about you. 'What is he doing right now?' 'Did he eat?'..."

day4_night_teacher_open_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_open_6.text: "Am I not qualified to be a teacher? Or... is it because these feelings are real that I feel this way?"

day4_night_teacher_tear.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_tear.text: *She gripped her coffee cup tightly and lowered her head. Her shoulders were trembling ever so slightly.*

day4_night_teacher_tear_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_tear_2.text: "...Ha, sorry. A teacher shouldn't be like this in front of a student."

day4_night_teacher_tear_choice.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_tear_choice.text: *There are tears glistening at the corner of her eyes.*
choices: Hold her hand
"Right now, you're not my teacher—you're a woman I care about"

day4_night_teacher_hold_2.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_hold_2.text: *I reached under the table and held her hand. Her cold fingers slowly grew warm.*

day4_night_teacher_hold_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_hold_3.text: "...We shouldn't do this here. Someone might see."

day4_night_teacher_hold_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_hold_4.text: "...But I don't want to let go."

day4_night_teacher_woman_2.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_woman_2.text: "Before you're a teacher, you're a person. It's okay to cry when you want to cry."

day4_night_teacher_woman_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_woman_4.text: "...If you say things like that, I'll really start crying, you dummy."

day4_night_teacher_real.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_real.text: "...You know, when I first became a teacher, I promised myself I'd never catch feelings for a student."

day4_night_teacher_real_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_real_2.text: "But then you came along... and broke that promise before I even noticed."

day4_night_teacher_real_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_real_3.text: "When I scolded you for being late, you just smiled and said, 'You look tired today, are you okay?' instead of making excuses."

day4_night_teacher_real_choice.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_real_choice.text: *She's speaking her heart with a trembling voice.*
choices: "After I graduate, I'll stand proudly by your side"
"This moment right now is precious. That's enough for me"
"If it's too hard for you, we can stop"

day4_night_teacher_graduate_3.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_graduate_3.text: "I'm not waiting—I'm going to become someone even better by then."

day4_night_teacher_graduate_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_graduate_4.text: "...God, seriously. You're way more mature than I am."

day4_night_teacher_present_2.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_present_2.text: "We can worry about tomorrow when it comes. Right now, I just want to be here with you."

day4_night_teacher_present_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_present_3.text: "...You're right. Right now... this time together is what matters."

day4_night_teacher_give_up_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_give_up_2.text: "...You dummy. I'm not struggling because I want to stop."

day4_night_teacher_give_up_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_give_up_3.text: "It's because my feelings are real... that's what scares me."

day4_night_teacher_resolve_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_resolve_2.text: I've made up my mind. I don't care if I lose my position as a teacher.

day4_night_teacher_resolve_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_resolve_3.text: If we get caught... I'll lock you in my room where no one can see you. Then only I can see you forever, right?

day4_night_teacher_resolve_end.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_resolve_end.text: I'm not joking. You're my accomplice now. You can never get out.

day4_night_teacher_farewell.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_farewell.text: *We left the cafe. We walked side by side on the night street. The teacher intertwined her fingers with mine and wouldn't let go.*

day4_night_teacher_farewell_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_farewell_2.text: ...I'll pretend to be a strict teacher again at school. We can't let the other kids notice.

day4_night_teacher_farewell_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_farewell_4.text: Yeah. So... don't get too close to other girls at school.

day4_night_teacher_farewell_5.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_night_teacher_farewell_5.text: You never know how I might torment you using my authority as a teacher. Got it?

day4_night_teacher_home.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_home.text: *Back home. The image of her at the café keeps coming back to me. The always confident, perfect teacher... showing her tears and vulnerability as just a woman.*

day4_night_teacher_home_2.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_home_2.text: *This secret is daunting... but it's precious. I'll never take her feelings lightly.*

day4_night_nurse_msg.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_msg.text: *10 PM. A message from the nurse. 'Still up? Can you come out for a bit if you have time?'*

day4_night_nurse_msg_2.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_msg_2.text: *...Her usual playful message, but why this late? Something feels off.*

day4_night_nurse_msg_3.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_msg_3.text: *I replied right away. 'Where should I go?'*

day4_night_nurse_msg_4.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_msg_4.text: *'The nurse's office at school. I'll leave the back door open.' ...The nurse's office?*

day4_night_nurse_arrive.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_arrive.text: *I arrived at the school. When I opened the nurse's office door, the room was dark with only a small lamp on. She was there.*

day4_night_nurse_arrive_2.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_arrive_2.text: "Wow, you actually came. Even though I called you out this late?"

day4_night_nurse_arrive_3.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_arrive_3.text: *She's smiling as usual, but... there are dark circles under her eyes. And several empty coffee cans on the desk.*
choices: "You look really tired"
"What's the real reason you called me here?"

day4_night_nurse_tired.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_tired.text: "Think so? It's been a hectic week. I'm fine though, really."

day4_night_nurse_real_reason.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_real_reason.text: "...The real reason? ...I wanted to see you."

day4_night_nurse_mask.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_mask.text: *She's smiling, but something feels forced. Like she's pushing too hard.*

day4_night_nurse_mask_2.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_mask_2.text: "...Actually, something kind of tough happened at school today."

day4_night_nurse_mask_3.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_mask_3.text: "The other teachers said, 'The nurse is always so cheerful—must be nice having no worries.'"

day4_night_nurse_mask_4.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_mask_4.text: "...'No worries.' Haha. That one... actually stung the most."

day4_night_nurse_mask_5.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_mask_5.text: "I was struggling too... but nobody asked. Not even once. Not a single 'are you okay?'"

day4_night_nurse_mask_6.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_mask_6.text: "In the nurse's office, kids come in and I smile for them, take care of them. But... who takes care of me?"

day4_night_nurse_lonely.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_lonely.text: "...When I go home, there's nobody. I live alone."

day4_night_nurse_lonely_2.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_lonely_2.text: "So... I started staying late at school. At least in this nurse's office, I don't feel so alone."

day4_night_nurse_lonely_3.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_lonely_3.text: *Her smile faded. For the first time, she's showing me her real face—without the jokes, without the teasing.*

day4_night_nurse_lonely_choice.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_lonely_choice.text: *I can see the real her now. What do I say?*
choices: Sit beside her and hold her
"From now on, I'll be the one to take care of you"

day4_night_nurse_hug_2.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_hug_2.text: "...Hey, all of a sudden... what are you..."

day4_night_nurse_hug_3.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_hug_3.text: *She was startled at first... but soon her hands gripped my clothes tightly.*

day4_night_nurse_hug_4.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_hug_4.text: "...This is weird. Have I ever wanted someone to hold me like this before?"

day4_night_nurse_hug_5.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_hug_5.text: "...Let's just stay like this. Just a little while."

day4_night_nurse_care_2.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_care_2.text: "You always take care of everyone else. It's your turn to be taken care of."

day4_night_nurse_care_3.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_care_3.text: "...Ha. How do you always hit me right where it hurts?"

day4_night_nurse_truth.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_truth.text: "...Actually, there's a reason I became a school nurse."

day4_night_nurse_truth_2.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_truth_2.text: "In high school, a close friend of mine got sick and was absent for a long time. The school nurse back then really took care of her."

day4_night_nurse_truth_3.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_truth_3.text: "I wanted to be someone like that too. Someone who's there for kids when they're hurting."

day4_night_nurse_truth_4.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_truth_4.text: "But in reality... they just saw me as 'the nurse who jokes around.' Not a real teacher."

day4_night_nurse_truth_5.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_truth_5.text: "They said being serious would ruin the vibe, so... I naturally started hiding behind laughs."

day4_night_nurse_truth_6.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_truth_6.text: "...I did the same with you. Approaching you with jokes and teasing. Because showing my real feelings... was terrifying."

day4_night_nurse_truth_choice.name: Me
choices: "I love the playful you and the real you—all of it"
"Thank you for showing me the real you"
"You don't have to be scared anymore. I'm here"

day4_night_nurse_accept_all_2.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_accept_all_2.text: "...You're the first person who's ever said that to me."

day4_night_nurse_accept_all_3.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_accept_all_3.text: "...I don't even know how to react. This is a first."

day4_night_nurse_thanks_2.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_thanks_2.text: "...I didn't know being honest with you could feel this comfortable."

day4_night_nurse_safe_2.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_safe_2.text: "...Maybe you're the person I feel most at ease with. Funny how that works."

day4_night_nurse_resolve_2.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_resolve_2.text: I won't wear a mask in front of you anymore. Instead... I want to lock you in this infirmary forever.

day4_night_nurse_resolve_3.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_resolve_3.text: I'll nurse you for the rest of my life... so I want you to keep being sick. So you only rely on me.

day4_night_nurse_resolve_end.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_resolve_end.text: I'm joking. ...Half joking. So if you get hurt, come straight to me. If you go anywhere else, I'll be really mad.

day4_night_nurse_farewell.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_farewell.text: *We left the infirmary and walked out of the school. The teacher linked her arm tightly with mine and wouldn't let go.*

day4_night_nurse_farewell_2.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_farewell_2.text: ...When you come to school tomorrow, drop by the infirmary first. I'll be checking attendance.

day4_night_nurse_farewell_4.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_farewell_4.text: "...It's strange. Around you, I keep getting honest. That's not like me at all."

day4_night_nurse_farewell_5.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_farewell_5.text: "...When we see each other at school again, I'll act normal. But my eyes won't be able to hide it."

day4_night_nurse_farewell_6.name: School Nurse
day4_night_nurse_farewell_6.text: "...So pay attention. When you walk past the nurse's office... just once."

day4_night_nurse_home.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_home.text: *Back home. The real face she showed me in the nurse's office keeps replaying. The person who was always joking and laughing... was actually the loneliest one of all.*

day4_night_nurse_home_2.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_home_2.text: *She's not alone anymore. I'm here. Tomorrow, I want to see her real smile.*

day4_night_regret.name: Me
day4_night_regret.text: *...I could have said it today. Under that sunset, it was the perfect moment.*

day4_night_regret_2.name: Me
day4_night_regret_2.text: *It's okay. There's tomorrow. Tomorrow, I'll definitely... tell them how I feel.*

day4_night_regret_msg.name: Me
day4_night_regret_msg.text: (A message came on my phone. "I had fun today. Are you free tomorrow too?")

day4_night_regret_reply.name: Me
day4_night_regret_reply.text: ("Yeah, let's meet tomorrow." I'll definitely say it tomorrow.)

day4_night_reflect.name: Me
day4_night_reflect.text: *And just like that, Saturday passed. Tomorrow... what should I do?*

day4_night_sleep.name: Me
day4_night_sleep.text: *When I close my eyes, their face appears. I wouldn't mind falling asleep like this.*

day4_final.name: Me
day4_final.text: *Saturday night deepens... Tomorrow is Sunday, the last day.*
